description: The deterministic phase spine for the Signature Funnel. Each P-phase names its produces_artifact, its thin _chk_sf_* preflight wrapper (DEFERS unless funnel_type == signature_funnel), and its fail-closed gate. The orchestrator run_signature_funnel.py runs this spine IN ORDER with no skips (operator key required) and issues the signed PROCESS-CERTIFICATE only on all-phases-pass. Image gen delegates to Skill 66 (model policy) then Skill 74 (kie_live_adapter.py, the one approved KIE transport; results recorded by scripts/kie74_receipt.py); media hosting (P4) and the funnel/page build (P7) delegate to the DELIVERY RAIL named by brief.delivery_rail, which signs one receipt line per hosted image and per built page (sf-delivery-rail-receipt/v1, schema/delivery-rail-receipt.schema.json); Skill 49 never imports or resolves the rail. CLIENT runtime uses the client's OWN providers, never Anthropic.

front_door.operator_key: the certificate HMAC is keyed by the operator key (ENF-16); a caller-supplied nonce is refused (AF-FUN-FRONT-DOOR); a direct orchestrator call without the operator key dies AF-FUN-FRONT-DOOR
front_door.rule: NOTHING generates copy/prompts, calls Kie, touches GHL, or mints a certificate except THROUGH signature-funnel-entry.sh.

phases.name: Image generation (DELEGATED to Skill 66 policy + Skill 74 transport)
phases.delegate: 66-kie-image (model policy) -> 74-kie-live-adapter :: kie_live_adapter.py (validate, preflight, prompt-budget, submit --mode active, save; text-to-image default + optional reference_images hook)
phases.gate: provenance enforced at P9 (Kie taskId + GHL host)

phases.name: Media hosting (DELEGATED to the delivery rail named in the brief)
phases.produces_artifact: media_ledger.json (hosted media URLs) + the hosting binding the launcher admits
phases.delegate: delivery rail named by brief.delivery_rail :: sf-delivery-rail-receipt/v1
phases.gate: run_signature_funnel._gate_p4_media (one operator-key-signed P4-MEDIA receipt line per ledger image; the ledger URL must equal the line's hosted_url; AF-FUN-DELEG-MEDIA); the same URL equality is re-checked at P9 (AF-FUN-IMG-HOST)

hosting_binding.required_keys: 83-black-friday-launcher/launcher_core/image_stages.py :: BINDING_KEYS (the launcher owns the binding schema; the key list is read from there, never copied)
hosting_binding.rule: A hosted URL alone is not an upload. The binding binds the CURRENT local artifact's SHA-256 to the exact run/page/revision, tenant/location, verified folder, remote media id and final URL. CDN transformations are expected: the local hash is the identity, the remote bytes are never compared to it. No record with a missing key is admitted.

phases.name: Per-page HTML fragment assembly
phases.gate: run_signature_funnel._gate_html_fragments (non-empty fragment per matrix profile; fail-closed) + prove_sf_build.html_fragment_violations (STR-18: every fragment is PARSED for its profile's data-section markers and count; run by the P7 prover)

phases.name: Funnel/page build (DELEGATED to the delivery rail named in the brief)
phases.delegate: delivery rail named by brief.delivery_rail :: sf-delivery-rail-receipt/v1
phases.gate: run_signature_funnel._gate_build (FIX-COPY-02: requires the FAB scorecard build/fab-artifact.json — copy echoed from copy_ledger.json — THEN prove_sf_build.py funnel-build QC >= 8.5 + non-empty preview URL per page; fail-closed). prove_sf_build.py also reads the evidence under the run dir (STR-18/S06-08/IMG-16): parsed page fragments, the delivery rail's operator-key-signed P7-BUILD receipt lines in delegation_receipts.jsonl (delegation_receipt.require_rail; one line per page type; QC recomputed as 10 x passing / total, preview URLs bound to passing lines) and the page-images wireframe + mockup set for every page
phases.produces_fab_scorecard: build/fab-artifact.json (copy_ledger echoed; the >=8.5 copy-substance gate scores this)

phases.name: Derived pages loop (U1/D1/U2/D2/TY)
phases.gate: run_signature_funnel._gate_derived_pages (derived set == matrix; U1/D1/U2/D2/TY labels; fail-closed)

phases.name: Optional 10 promo emails (handoff)
phases.gate: AF-FUN-P10-EMAILS: when the brief's email_offer is accepted, working/emails/emails.json must carry a Skill 50 certificate sha before the certificate is minted; the certificate names the state (accepted or declined)

chk_wrappers.note: Thin (<=6-line) preflight wrappers appended to the orchestrator's PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED; each DEFERS (returns OK) unless the run's funnel_type == signature_funnel, then shells its prover.

delegation_seams.images: 66-kie-image (model policy, N43 ratio rules) -> 74-kie-live-adapter / kie_live_adapter.py (16:9 and 3:4 slots, 2K default; reference hook uses the live schema's image field)
delegation_seams.media_hosting: delivery rail named by brief.delivery_rail :: sf-delivery-rail-receipt/v1 (P4-MEDIA, one signed line per ledger image)
delegation_seams.page_build: delivery rail named by brief.delivery_rail :: sf-delivery-rail-receipt/v1 (P7-BUILD, one signed line per page type)
delegation_seams.client_provider_rule: CLIENT runtime tiers the client's OWN configured providers (strongest -> copy+QC; mid -> prompts/HTML/JSON; cheapest -> catalog/poll). NEVER Anthropic on a client box.

AF-FUN-INTAKE-MISSING.trigger: a required intake answer (by funnel size) is missing/empty

AF-FUN-INTAKE-TRUTHGATE.trigger: community URL / bonus / founder-text not confirmed (Q16)

AF-FUN-PROFILE-UNKNOWN.trigger: page_type not in the profiles map

AF-FUN-SECTION-MISSING.trigger: a required section for the page profile is absent, OR a page type the locked 3/5/7 funnel_matrix requires has no page in the copy ledger (main-only ledger; STR-19), OR the ledger contradicts the locked brief size / the size is unresolved (fail-closed)

AF-FUN-SECTION-EXTRA.trigger: a page carries a section not allowed by its profile

AF-FUN-SECTION-ORDER.trigger: sections duplicated / not ascending / bad id

AF-FUN-SEC1-TITLE.trigger: Section 1 does not contain the product title

AF-FUN-PAIN-QUESTION.trigger: a pain section is written in question format ('?')

AF-FUN-PAIN-2ND-PERSON.trigger: a pain section is not in 2nd person (no you/your)

AF-FUN-PAIN-CTA.trigger: a pain section missing a labeled CTA

AF-FUN-SEC5-WORDS.trigger: Section 5 outside 18-30 words (under-length is as much a hard miss as over-length)

AF-FUN-SEC5-LEAD.trigger: Section 5 does not start 'That's the reason why...'

AF-FUN-SEC6-WORDS.trigger: Section 6 outside 18-30 words (under-length is as much a hard miss as over-length)

AF-FUN-BENEFIT-WORDS.trigger: a benefit section (8/9/10) outside 18-30 words (under-length is as much a hard miss as over-length)

AF-FUN-BENEFIT-NO-CTA.trigger: a benefit section (8/9) carries a CTA (forbidden)

AF-FUN-SEC10-CTA.trigger: Section 10 missing its inspirational CTA button

AF-FUN-SEC12-STRUGGLE.trigger: Section 12 part 2 does not start 'I used to be just like you...'

AF-FUN-SEC8REPL-NAME.trigger: replacement Section 8 name mismatches the profile

AF-FUN-TY1-TITLE.trigger: Thank-You TY-1 does not name the product title

AF-FUN-TY2-STEPBAND.trigger: a Thank-You TY-2 step outside 89-116 chars

AF-FUN-PROMPT-FLOOR.trigger: image prompt under the KIE rule-12 floor (shared kie_prompt_enforcer)

AF-FUN-PROMPT-CEILING.trigger: image prompt over the KIE rule-12 ceiling (shared kie_prompt_enforcer)

AF-FUN-PROMPT-NEGATIVE.trigger: no negative block ('Do not ...') in the prompt

AF-FUN-PROMPT-TYPO.trigger: text-bearing prompt lacks spelling-lock/words, or non-text prompt lacks 'no text'

AF-FUN-PROMPT-STYLE-CARD.trigger: the intake names a Skill 45 style_card_id (Q18) but a prompt does not carry that card's LONG tier verbatim in block 8 ahead of the negatives, or the card cannot be read from the design library

AF-FUN-PROMPT-COVERAGE.trigger: prompt ledger is missing a required (page_type, section) image slot for the funnel size (partial ledger)

AF-FUN-IMG-COVERAGE.trigger: media ledger is missing a required (page_type, section) image slot for the funnel size (partial image set)

AF-FUN-P10-EMAILS.trigger: P10-EMAIL: the brief's email_offer is accepted but working/emails/emails.json is missing or carries no Skill 50 certificate sha (64-hex certificate_sha), or email_offer is neither accepted nor declined

AF-FUN-HTML-FRAGMENT.trigger: a pages/<profile>.fragment.html is missing/empty for a matrix page

AF-FUN-GRAPH-NODES.trigger: node id set does not match the MASTERDOC §3 matrix for the size

AF-FUN-GRAPH-EDGE.trigger: an edge references an unknown node or carries an illegal on-label

AF-FUN-GRAPH-TERMINAL.trigger: thank-you is not the unique terminal, or a non-terminal node is a dead end

AF-FUN-GRAPH-BRANCH.trigger: an upsell node is missing its accept or decline (one-click) edge

AF-FUN-GRAPH-REACH.trigger: a node is unreachable from main, or cannot reach thank-you

AF-FUN-BUILD-FAB.trigger: the FAB scorecard build/fab-artifact.json is absent/unreadable or echoes no copy — the >=8.5 copy-substance gate cannot run (fail-closed; FIX-COPY-02)

AF-FUN-BUILD-MALFORMED.trigger: build_receipt.json absent/unreadable or carries no pages (fail-closed)

AF-FUN-BUILD-QC.trigger: build receipt qc_score missing/non-numeric or below the 8.5 floor

AF-FUN-BUILD-PREVIEW.trigger: a built page has no non-empty http(s) preview_url

AF-FUN-DERIVE-LEDGER.trigger: derived_pages.json absent/malformed, wrong derived set, or bad U1/D1/U2/D2/TY label

AF-FUN-TY-PITCH.trigger: an offer/product NAME appears on the thank-you page

AF-FUN-TY-PRICE.trigger: a price/monetary token appears on the thank-you page

AF-FUN-TY-CTA.trigger: a sale/offer CTA (non-utility) on the thank-you page

AF-FUN-IMG-HOST.trigger: media URL is not the hosted URL the P4 delivery-rail receipt recorded for that image (ledger-only: not a well-formed non-placeholder http(s) URL)

AF-FUN-OFFER-LEDGER-MISSING.trigger: no offer names to prove absent (fail-closed)

AF-FUN-TY-MISSING.trigger: no thank-you page (cannot prove no-pitch; fail-closed)

AF-FUN-IMG-EMPTY.trigger: no image records (cannot prove provenance; fail-closed)

AF-FUN-CERT-PHASE-GAP.trigger: phase orders not contiguous 0..N (a phase skipped)

AF-FUN-CERT-PHASE-FAIL.trigger: a phase status != pass / all_phases_pass not true

AF-FUN-CERT-SIGNATURE.trigger: HMAC signature invalid for the operator key (tamper/forgery)

AF-FUN-PROCESS-INTEGRITY.trigger: process certificate invalid -> funnel is NOT done

AF-FUN-FRONT-DOOR.trigger: orchestrator called without the operator key, or with a caller-supplied nonce (refused; ENF-16)

AF-FUN-CANONICAL-BYPASS.trigger: run working files hand-roll GHL REST / mail sender / raw Kie createTask / a KIE client script (Skill 74 result files under receipts/kie74/ are allow-listed)

AF-FUN-HASH-PIN.trigger: enforcement-core sha256 does not match SF-PROVER-PIN.sha256

AF-FUN-INTAKE-PERSONA-LOG.trigger: persona-selection-log absent or names no registered persona slug (copywriter-persona Step-0 grounding); FIX-XC-02a fail-closed

AF-FUN-MODEL-TIER.trigger: model-content-receipt absent or authoring tier is not an execution/content tier (client's own strongest model must write copy); FIX-XC-09e

AF-FUN-BUILD-PAGESET.trigger: the build receipt does not carry every page type the locked 3/5/7 funnel matrix requires (an under-sized receipt — a 7-step funnel with 3 pages — no longer certifies); A10/T0-11

AF-FUN-BUILD-SIZE.trigger: the locked funnel size is unresolved (no brief size and no receipt funnel_size), so the required page set cannot be computed (fail-closed); A10/T0-11

AF-FUN-BUILD-SIZE-MISMATCH.trigger: the build receipt declares a funnel_size that contradicts the locked brief size (the receipt does not describe this funnel); A10/T0-11

AF-FUN-BUILD-PREVIEW-PLACEHOLDER.trigger: a page preview_url resolves to a placeholder/example/loopback host (a caller-authored stand-in is not a built preview); A10/T0-11

AF-FUN-HTML-SECTIONS.trigger: a pages/<profile>.fragment.html lacks its root page marker, does not carry exactly the profile's data-section markers in order (12 for main, 8 for derived pages, TY-1..TY-3 for thank-you), or a section carries no real text (a fragment of 'x' fails; STR-18)

AF-FUN-BUILD-QC-RECORD.trigger: no signed delivery-rail QC record: the P7-BUILD receipt lines are absent, unsigned, forged, for another run, authored by a certified module, break schema/delivery-rail-receipt.schema.json or miss a required page type; or the QC recomputed from the lines (10 x passing / total) is below the 8.5 floor, or the receipt qc_score is higher than the recomputed one (a receipt that only says 9.0 fails; STR-18/S06-08)

AF-FUN-BUILD-PREVIEW-UNBOUND.trigger: a receipt preview_url is not a URL that a passing delivery-rail P7 receipt line recorded (a real-looking host the rail never built; STR-18)

AF-FUN-BUILD-VISUAL.trigger: a page of the funnel has no wireframe/mockup set: page-images/page-images-receipt.json absent, or a page lacks its desktop-wireframe / mobile-tablet / visual-mockup stage-executor-record with images, or a record does not match the receipt sha256 (no certificate without visual direction; IMG-16)

AF-FUN-DELEG-IMAGES.trigger: P3-IMAGES: media ledger carries no image records or an image has no real image-provider task id (file existence is no longer proof of delegated image generation); A10/T0-09

AF-FUN-DELEG-MEDIA.trigger: P4-MEDIA: a ledger image carries a URL that differs from the hosted_url the delivery rail's signed receipt recorded for it, or the ledger is absent (an un-uploaded image is not a delegated upload); A10/T0-09

AF-FUN-DELEG-RECEIPT-SELF-AUTHORED.trigger: a delegated-phase provider receipt is present but SELF-AUTHORED by the certificate's own subject (the run stamped its own evidence) — the strongest A10/T0-09 protection; the same validator also rejects a non-2xx status, a placeholder response/remote id, and a ledger row no provider was called for (-STATUS / -ID / -COVERAGE / -MISSING-PHASE / -MALFORMED / -ABSENT)
